method.arms: One tree, no worktree. The probes take VALE_BOTS. src/sim/_vfy7_pre (bots at 0aeac587b, pre-lane), src/sim/_vfy7_e2c (e2c4925e5, the live ship) and src/sim/_vfy7_h65 (65bc15aaf, the previous HEAD) were git-archive copies beside HEAD's src/sim/bots. Every arm ran with the HEAD probe and the HEAD sim. All three copies were deleted after the runs.
method.sim: probe_sim_bot_tactics under heavy.py. HEAD, pre, e2c and h65 on s701-764 (64 RIFT, cut at 30:00, + 24 FRAY per tier). HEAD, pre and h65 RIFT on fresh s801-832 (32 per tier). HEAD and h65 BRIDGE s701-724. HEAD at default seeds (the gate). probe_sim_bot_soak quick. Full soak --full --lineup shuffle on --seed0 1 and 21 (labels vfy7_s1, vfy7_s21). Pairs are matched per seed and reported as mean +- SE of the paired difference.
method.live: Real Chrome (pw.mjs, GPU on) against two private vite servers, hmr off, private dep caches: :5366 served the HEAD tree; :5367 served the same tree with a resolveId plugin that pointed src/sim/bots at the h65 copy (no src edit). Seat 0 was the round-1 scripted player with the per-second core-hit monitor (_tmp_vfy_ai_brain.js). Runs: RIFT veteran s5 and FRAY veteran s9 on HEAD; RIFT veteran s5, s3, s7, adept s5 and novice s5 on HEAD and on h65, paired. I looked at the screenshots: they are real renders, for example the dive engage at 11:01.
method.determinism_check: The h65 arm reproduces round 6 exactly. Live RIFT veteran s5 on h65 ends by core at 1638.9 s with 8 fighter-seconds of fit defenders more than 25 m from a hit Bell (round 6: 27:19, 8). Live FRAY veteran s9 on HEAD is the same as rounds 3-6: 190 low-health episodes, 96 stayed, 65 retreated, 28 died. The implementer's pooled tables reproduce to the digit: pace vs pre +0.28+-0.50 / -0.48+-0.42 / -0.12+-0.44, vs HEAD +0.18+-0.23 / -0.32+-0.26 / -0.30+-0.16, fit and away 28.7 / 6.6 / 4.5 (h65 41.0 / 11.5 / 9.6). FRAY is byte-identical to h65 in 72 of 72 games (s701) and BRIDGE in 72 of 72 (s701-724).
method.code_read: team.ts thinkBaseAnswer runs only on RIFT with the posts off, for tiers with baseAnswerDelay < Infinity, before baseAnswerUntil. It reads only the team's own structure health and perc.enemyFighters (seen fighters), so it uses only what a player could know. Hourbell/Bell get +1. Defenders are released by g.until (1.5 s after the last think that saw hits) or under 35 % health. The structHitAt map it now fills while the posts are off is read elsewhere only by hitRecently() for a post holder, so it has no side effect. No new fog read and 0 hidden casts recorded at every tier.
method.cleanup: The three _vfy7 bot folders, both private vite configs, their dep caches, the copied web brain and the two tagged live scripts were removed. Vite :5366 and :5367 were stopped. No worktree was created (the two listed were already there), no probe, vite or Chrome processes are left, and all heavy slots are free. Raw data is in the session scratchpad under v7/. Soak reports are in _harness/_reports/fw_W4_soak_vfy7_* and live reports in _harness/_reports/vfy7*_r1_* (both gitignored).

head_vs_live_e2c: For a player, HEAD is better than the live bots. Games are 1.6-2.3 min shorter and reach 30:00 much less often (7 / 2 / 3 vs 18 / 8 / 9 of 64). Dithering is much lower (-2.2 / -0.7 / -2.5 a game). Fighters idle less beside a siege (-5 to -12 s a game). There are fewer Wick-only falls beside fit defenders, and lone-enemy collapses are more frequent. With this build, fit fighters standing off a hit base dropped from 3-4x live to 1.7x (veteran) and 2.1x (adept). Still worse than live on base defence: unanswered intrusions at novice and adept (+0.8 / +0.95 a game), veteran base structures falling (+0.8 a game), and novice fit and away (3.3x).
head_vs_h65: No regression a player could see. RIFT pace is the same or shorter (-0.3 min at adept and veteran, +0.18+-0.23 at novice). Laning is identical. FRAY and BRIDGE are byte-identical. Dither is slightly lower, and the base answer is visibly faster in the live seed-5 Bell siege. The live veteran s5 run reaching the 28:00 cap is the one live difference, and paired sim pace does not support it as a trend.
